title: AI Frontiers: Education, FinTech & India's R&D Future
snippet: Dr. Rajesh Gupta, Founding Dean of the School of Computing, Information and Data Sciences (SCIDS) at UC San Diego, participated as a featured speaker in the 'AI Frontiers: Education, FinTech & India's R&D Future' dialogue at the GIFT International Fintech Institute (GIFT IFI) in GIFT City, India.
